question: What ritual fruit does this substance grant at the end of circle-worship?
premises: The substance is used at the end of circle-worship.
It is described as giving a specific fruit.
That fruit is identified as the fruit of the vājapeya.
inference: Taken at the end of circle-worship, it grants the fruit of the vājapeya sacrifice.
plain_english: At the end of circle-worship, that gives the fruit of the vājapeya sacrifice.
